topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing and outlines the themes of the lecture.

topics.label: Principles of innate immune recognition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish how the innate immune system identifies infections and tissue damage using conserved molecular patterns and germline-encoded receptors.

topics.label: Pattern recognition receptor families and signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine specific receptor families and intracellular complexes that transduce danger signals into pro-inflammatory gene expression.

topics.label: Inflammatory response propagation, leukocyte trafficking, and systemic pathology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the cellular dynamics and physiological consequences of active inflammation across local and systemic levels.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic containment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the biological mechanisms that terminate acute inflammation, rebuild damaged tissues, and contain persistent pathogens.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic delivers the closing remarks and previews the topic of the next lecture.
